source: Independent source-informed implementation of the placement and DOM API. No upstream runtime is included. Public declarations and unchanged test sources retain their MIT attribution; this is not a clean-room claim.
scope: The full utils and utils/dom export surface used below Floating UI core/dom/react, including VentiMath Tiptap popovers, dropdowns and tooltips. Callers are not migrated by this package.

implementation.targetScope: Placement helpers and DOM ancestry/containment utilities.

changes: Fallback placement arrays belong to each call; mutating one cannot corrupt future calls.

Iterative nearest-overflow and ancestor enumeration avoid recursion and repeated array concatenation. A 20,000-node control overflows upstream on Node; Bun tail-call optimization already handles the nearest-ancestor control.
DOM type checks use available realm constructors and work when a host exposes window without copying every constructor onto globalThis. isWebKit always returns a boolean.
Current 0.2.12 padding semantics, including nullish defaults and inherited side values, are preserved.

verification.upstream: 21 unchanged upstream tests; only imports redirected, with the used assertion methods backed by node:assert/strict and genuine JSDOM.
verification.callers: Chrome executes pinned core 1.7.5/dom 1.7.6 against upstream and VPM utils: 24 placement/RTL/middleware cases plus overflow, shadow slots, iframes and modal top layers.
verification.packaging: Packed npm/Bun installs, Node/Bun CJS/ESM, browser bundling and TypeScript 7 DOM consumers.
